about: What each commit of this hour changed: its message beyond the subject, its session (the Claude-Session trailer), and its files with lines added and removed (git numstat; at most 40 files a commit). Written by tools/agents-commits.mjs. The list of commits: data/agents/commits.json.

6c7cb2415abb085f3a609f8244609865c127d1bb.body:
tools/entities-link.mjs is the 'after' generator the conductor's slots name. The
linker leaves the librarian's file viewers (view/) as they are. app/lens/ now
keeps to the designer's switches and colours and adds only the marks for linked
names by type, the page's counts in the Lens slot, and window.StormLens.show.

13eb44eaed534fbc2e4e86212be5f6a4ed18ec25.body:
board/items/<id>.json: one card each, ids permanent, each with its evidence (timeline rows, decision edges, files),
what would close it, and its history. 8 questions nobody with the authority has answered yet, 4 conflicts between
sources, 37 asks (19 wait on Dinis, ranked by what they block), 59 jobs, 9 tasks a reader could do now.
tools/board-build.mjs --out DIR writes board/index.json, board/tasks.json and the pages (index, for-dinis, tasks,
one per card); --check lists what a wake must look at. It writes no tracked file and reads no history.
The pages are served once the generator is in the build's list (asked of the conductor).

22d1e0b2c7d4a7bc0d4f6dcca7a431d778960adb.body:
labs/timelines: lanes, known-when (a scrubber), story. labs/decisions: flow (a query, never the whole graph), lead-times, days.
labs/weather: stations (warned against observed), day-bands (hour by hour), models (dashed, named, never our forecast).
One core (app/labs/labs.js) reading only the site's published JSON; one hook, Labs.openItem(id), for the reader's panel to replace.
labs/index.md gives a verdict on each; agents/labs/status.json has the asks.

b708dbed2ceaaf66a9c6d3d27fffab5379744083.body: tools/capture.mjs (screenshot, HTML, visible text, sha256 of each, robots.txt obeyed, output outside git), tools/capture-records.mjs (records, index, timeline rows to evidence ids, vault push), app/evidence/ (the screenshot read from the display vault in the browser and checked against the record), data/vaults.json (the display vault's read key only), the session key's public half.

5176f5eeb5c3804e72f4a8157407117d663e86ba.body:
Found missing by incident.studio@: the 21:23 change of Lisbon's red rain was
in the graph twice (the researcher's warning and IPMA's CAP message) with no
edge between them. A recorded warning matches the message of the same level
and type whose start is its effect start; a warning in force for Lisbon
matches the message with the same type, level, start and end. Seven edges
today; no match, no edge.

ec7471fc124e21f6e8c6cf200f52ae0185850625.body:
sources/index.md and sources.json list every outside body the site cites,
official bodies first. sources/meteoalarm/ describes MeteoAlarm, quotes its
terms, maps its APIs (the EDR archive needs a key) and browses our dated copy
of the Portugal feed. tools/source-meteoalarm.mjs records every read and what
changed; the full bytes go to a data vault, git keeps hashes.

747d8321bbc0ea3bce19ea51bea1a841f1cc5e1e.body:

entities/seed.json + tools/entities-make.mjs -> entities/<type>/<id>.json, index.json:
every edge carries the label, source and time read of the row or decision it names.
tools/entities-build.mjs --out DIR (pages) and --out DIR --link (the linker, after
the pages are built). app/lens/: the marks and window.StormLens. Session key in
data/keys.json.

For the conductor: admin/build/build.mjs needs tools/entities-build.mjs in the
generator list and one call with --link after the last page is written.

2d246d4bd6d47297f8967259b454715e11deb771.body:
Round 1 of Dinis's direction of 02:10 (BRIEF.md). /app/graph/ never draws
the whole graph first: it starts from a question (eight presets, or
"everything about" a thing within 1 to 3 steps), each with its own address
(?q=, ?node=). Filters by kind of thing, verb and label; three layouts (by
links, in order of time, in lanes by kind); pressing a node reads it and
brings in its links, with hide and "open as its own graph"; pressing a link
reads the link. The answer is also a list with every item linked.
/app/graph/ontology/: the kinds of thing and the verbs drawn from the
ontology and the graph; every verb now has an inverse (ontology.json).
/app/graph/lead-times/: the line of time as its own

0fde362b6f1f6e590a6393d170557bc020988b7d.body:

chapter's script right (click a line to jump), controls under both; the screen's width is used, up to 1560 px.
